name: FLIGHTDECK
shortDescription: Self-hosted deployment control plane for containers. Railway-style UI, your own hardware.
overview: A self-hosted deployment control plane for containers with Railway-style ergonomics on your own hardware. A small Rust agent on each host discovers labelled containers and streams their logs, metrics and status over WebSocket to a TypeScript control plane and a React UI, with gated restart and redeploy from the browser.

highlights.d: A Rust agent per server, against Docker or a rootless Podman socket, with automatic reconnect and live event fan-out.
Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY fan-out, OIDC/JWT role-based access, and a read-only operator audit trail.
Durable log search via an optional Loki/Grafana/Prometheus stack, plus a notifications hub.

architecture.d: A TypeScript (Hono) service with two WebSocket endpoints, one for agents and one for browsers, keeping a bounded in-memory log tail per service and fanning events out to the UI.
One small static Rust binary per server that discovers containers labelled flightdeck.enable=true via the bollard Docker API and forwards logs, reconnecting automatically.
A versioned protocol package: zod schemas on the TypeScript side mirrored by serde structs in the Rust agent.

techDetails: CORE: Rust agent + TypeScript control plane + React 19 UI
HA: Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY fan-out for multi-instance
AUTH: OIDC/JWT roles, constant-time agent tokens, local accounts (scrypt)
OBSERVABILITY: optional Loki / Grafana / Prometheus stack
TIERS: lite / medium / full via FD_PROFILE flags

name: ADW (AGENTIC DEV WORKFLOW)
shortDescription: A Python orchestrator for structured, crash-resumable AI agent runs.
overview: Agentic Developer Workflow: a Python-level abstraction for running structured, repeatable AI agent workflows end to end, with crash-resume so an interrupted run picks up where it left off instead of starting over.

highlights.d: A run loop split into per-kind step handlers, with convergence signals and architectural gates.
Idempotent tasks so an interrupted run resumes cleanly rather than latching a stale state.
Uses git-local-issue as an issue sink and cargo-structure-diff as an architectural deep gate.

techDetails: ORCHESTRATION: per-kind step handlers with convergence signals
RESUME: idempotent tasks survive crashes and restarts

name: SIMHARNESS
shortDescription: A deterministic, genre-agnostic harness for running and replaying coding agents reproducibly.
overview: A deterministic, genre-agnostic harness for running and replaying coding agents reproducibly: the eval substrate most agent setups lack. Built around a discrete-action seam with trace shrinking and porcelain action helpers.

highlights.d: Run, replay and shrink agent traces reproducibly for reliable evaluation.
A discrete-action core that drives spatial and non-spatial workers alike.
Auto-generated API docs and a one-command quality gate.

techDetails: CORE: discrete-action seam, genre-agnostic
EVAL: trace shrinking and reproducible replay

name: PANEKIT
shortDescription: Headless terminal-UI test harness in Rust. Drive and assert real TUI state, no screen-scraping.
overview: A headless terminal-UI output and test harness in Rust (panedrive plus paneview). Drive and assert real TUI state instead of screen-scraping, with crash and false-pass detection for honest CI results.

highlights.d: Press real keys and read real state from a TUI with no terminal attached.
CI-grade run results with crash and false-pass detection.
Shipped as two crates on crates.io (panedrive and paneview).

techDetails: CRATES: panedrive (driver) + paneview (state seam)
CI: crash and false-pass detection built in

name: CARGO-STRUCTURE-DIFF
shortDescription: A Rust CI gate that fails the build when a crate's module architecture drifts.
overview: A deterministic CI gate for Rust architecture. It builds a structural IR of a crate and fails the build when its module architecture drifts, turning 'keep it clean' into an automated check.

highlights.d: Compares a crate's module structure against a baseline and flags drift.
A stable IR so the same code always yields the same verdict.
Available on crates.io, installable with cargo install.

techDetails: IR: stable structural representation of a crate
GATE: fails the build on architecture drift

name: GIT-LOCAL-ISSUE (GLI)
shortDescription: Distributed, offline-first issue tracker that stores issues as native Git refs. No server.
overview: A distributed, offline-first issue tracker that stores issues natively in Git under refs/issues/*. No external database and no server: issues travel with the repo and sync over ordinary git.

highlights.d: Issues live in refs/issues/*, versioned alongside the code they describe.
Create, edit and close issues with no network and no server.
Shipped on crates.io via cargo-dist.

techDetails: STORAGE: issues in refs/issues/* with UUIDv7 ids
SYNC: travels with the repo, no server required

name: LAZYDASH
shortDescription: Keyboard-driven terminal dashboard for GitHub Projects, backed by local Git issues.
overview: A keyboard-driven terminal dashboard for GitHub Projects, with activity and calendar views. It can back local issues with git-local-issue for an offline-capable board.

highlights.d: Navigate GitHub Projects and multiple repos entirely from the keyboard.
Activity and calendar views derived from issue history.
Optional git-local-issue backend for offline work.

techDetails: VIEWS: activity and calendar from issue history
BACKEND: optional git-local-issue for offline work

name: COUNTER-INDEX
shortDescription: A high-throughput OP_NET data indexer: index, store and stream on-chain data.
overview: A high-throughput OP_NET data indexer: index, store and stream on-chain data. The read-side infrastructure for building on OP_NET, smart contracts on Bitcoin.

highlights.d: Index, store and stream raw on-chain data to downstream consumers.
Read-only exposure and routing awareness for safe reads.
TypeScript services with Docker and type-aware tooling.

techDetails: PIPELINE: index, store and stream on-chain data
DEPLOY: containerized TypeScript services

name: MAXIBRIDGE
shortDescription: Cross-chain EVM to OP_NET bridge (smart contracts on Bitcoin). Audited by PeckShield.
overview: A cross-chain bridge between EVM chains and OP_NET (smart contracts on Bitcoin), with wrapped-asset contracts. Audited by PeckShield, with every finding resolved.

highlights.d: Reviewed by PeckShield; PVE findings addressed with pause guards and per-finding dispositions.
Wrapped ERC20 and OP20 assets bridged between EVM and OP_NET.
EVM and OP_NET test suites covering the bridge paths.

techDetails: AUDIT: PeckShield review, findings resolved
SUITES: EVM + OP_NET test coverage

name: DAEMON-WALLET
shortDescription: A Rust terminal EVM wallet that bridges to the browser. Daemon core plus Chrome front end.
overview: A Rust terminal EVM wallet (externally owned account) that bridges to Google Chrome. A daemon core with a dedicated vault crate plus a browser front end, exploring a terminal-first wallet UX.

highlights.d: A cargo workspace with a dedicated vault crate for key handling.
Connects the terminal daemon to a Google Chrome front end.
Signs and sends EVM transactions as an externally owned account.

techDetails: WORKSPACE: cargo workspace with a dedicated vault crate
BRIDGE: Rust daemon connects to a Chrome front end
